rule_text;: deny traverse on nodes (*) to Medical_Secretary;
grant traverse on nodes (m:MedicalRecord) to Medical_Secretary;
grant create on nodes (p:Patient) where p.age >= 65 to SeniorDoctor;
grant traverse on nodes (p:Patient) where p.age >= 0 to SeniorDoctor;
grant traverse on relationships (t:TREATS) where t.age >= 18 AND t.age <= 65 to Department_Head;
grant read{approval_status} on nodes (t:Treatment) to Nurse;
deny read{*} on nodes (t:Treatment) to Nurse;
grant create on relationships (r:WORKS_ON) where r.year > 2020 to Nurse;
grant traverse on relationships (r:WORKS_ON) where r.year > 2020 to Nurse;
grant create on nodes (e:Document) to Nurse;
grant traverse on nodes (e:Document) to Nurse;
deny traverse on nodes (e:Document) to Nurse;
deny create on nodes (e:Document) to Nurse;
